item.description:

item.title: AI fuels more than half of cybercrime in Africa as scams surge – Interpol
item.description:

item.title: Flowise Is Shutting Down
item.description:

The code will remain visible indefinitely, but issues and PRs will be locked and npm packages and Docker images will be marked deprecated. Moving forward, Flowise source code will still remain on Github and the Apache 2.
